name: eventKit
description: A lazy World of Warcraft event bridge with ownership scopes and isolated listeners.
summary: Lazy game-event subscriptions with scopes and isolated listeners; unit events, combat-log routing and coalescing as optional parts.

Units.description: ConnectUnit and OnceUnit: events filtered to one or two unit tokens on a bounded set of unit-filter Frames.

CombatLog.description: ConnectCombatLog: the combat log read once per event and routed by sub-event.

Coalescing.description: Coalesce and Derive: events collected into one callback per interval, and values recomputed after a quiet period, timed by TimerKit (a lane by SchedulerKit).
